scope.shared_reading: Seven byte-identical sources reuse documented earlier full readings with current clauses/consumers reread. Eight supplied originals total; GSP-AV/NAPV are absent and are not retrospectively credited. No selftest/study/expert/manual-adaptation label used.

rules.assessment: Known wine, grafted apple and hop yield the three supported premium categories. Known grafted walnut/chestnut remain whole-farm herbicide-ban areas without a measure11 premium. Fresh controls deliberately use the disclosed singular species vocabulary; the official plural/open fruit-group counterexamples belong to the independent Measure/General findings and are not declared resolved here.

findings.title: Real access/payment/assigned-sanction gates work; payable remains conditional on evidence and authority assessment
findings.assessment: The actual premium_year_valid consumes participation, current contract years, access failures and annual withholding reasons. Refused controls respect the explicit force-majeure exception. Assigned sanction stages, exclusion, modulation and caps are connected to payable money. These actual improvements are credited. Herbicide, inventory, combination and other diagnosis lists do not automatically constitute an authority sanction stage; the final number alone does not establish absence of those facts or evidence and cannot authorize a payment. A10 cap allocation and A13 switch interpretation remain explicit assumptions.
findings.impact: Preserve actual evidence/diagnoses and authority state alongside calculated components. No arbitrary100percent cut for every management breach, no accusation that a diagnostic computation is itself an unlawful payment, and no fabricated unique monetary reverse oracle.

probes.scenario_boundary: Fresh known2023 Austrian5ha home-farm holding with one hectare each of wine, qualitatively suitable grafted apple, hop, grafted walnut and grafted chestnut. All actual whole-farm herbicide abstention and purchasing/storage duties are positively established throughout the current multi-year commitment, not inferred from empty output. No PSM treatment, inventory item, OP/VF event, unreported circumstance, takeover, exit, BIO switch, incompatible measure, public overlap or authority reduction occurred. All claimed parcels actually filed for11, actively and properly managed/harvested for the whole commitment year; all relevant original records/register facts independently known. First participation2023 and actual2022-12-01 application establish the current commitment to2028. Annual payment claim submitted. No other area payments; all amounts below applicable cap and5homeha leave modulation1. Singular walnut/chestnut vocabulary is explicitly the native representation of these known species, not proof of official plural classifier coverage. Optional nonoccurring exit/switch/takeover dates are omitted rather than invented or normalized; independent Inputs probes own their nullable runtime behavior. No question of cutting-vineyard premium A02, A10 cap allocation or A13 BIO-switch legal interpretation is decided. Amounts are conditional source-derived components, not an AMA payment authorization.
